easy.def: A bird that turns white in winter.

more.def: A plump grouse of cold places whose feathers turn white in winter.
examples: A ptarmigan blended into the snow.
The ptarmigan turns white in winter.

easy.def: A big flying reptile from the time of the dinosaurs.

more.def: A large flying reptile with a long crest and no teeth that lived at the time of the dinosaurs.
examples: A pteranodon soared over the sea.
The pteranodon had wings wider than a car.
Fossils of a pteranodon were found in Kansas.

easy.def: A flying animal from the time of the dinosaurs.

more.def: A flying reptile with leathery wings that lived at the time of the dinosaurs.
examples: A pterodactyl soared over the ancient sea.
Fossils of a pterodactyl show long, thin wings.
The pterodactyl caught fish with its long beak.

easy.def: A flying reptile from the time of the dinosaurs.

more.def: A flying reptile with leathery wings that lived at the time of the dinosaurs.
examples: A pterosaur soared over the swamp.
Pterosaurs had wings made of skin.
The pterosaur was not a dinosaur.
